summary: Barbados's foreign ministry lists most nationalities as needing no visa: US and Canadian citizens and many Commonwealth nationals can stay up to six months, EU citizens 90 days in any 180, and some nationalities 28 to 90 days. Every traveller must complete the online Immigration and Customs Form before arrival.

fee.notes: Single-entry visa, permitting one entry within three months. A multiple-entry visa, for entries within six months, costs USD 211.

Individual applicants; a family bundle costs USD 3,000. Fees are non-refundable and due within 28 days of approval. Applicants must show annual income of at least USD 50,000 and/or the means to support themselves during the stay.

fee.notes: Application fee listed by the Immigration Department, paid when you submit Form B (application under section 13(3) of the Immigration Act to vary your period of stay) at its headquarters with a valid ticket for the longer stay, your passport and one photo.

source.name: Barbados Immigration Department — Extensions of Stay

passportValidity.text: The Immigration Department says your passport must be valid for the duration of your trip.

source.name: Barbados Immigration Department — Visitors to Barbados

vaccinations.name: Yellow fever
vaccinations.text: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required from travelers aged one year and over arriving from a country on Barbados's list of yellow fever countries, which differs from WHO's own risk list. WHO's risk list includes Caribbean-area countries such as Trinidad and Tobago and Guyana.

source.name: WHO, International Travel and Health, Annex 1 — countries requiring proof of vaccination against yellow fever
source.instrument: International Health Regulations (2005), Article 36 and Annex 7; WHO International Travel and Health, Annex 1, 18 November 2022 (revised 3 January 2023)

travelInsurance.text: No official source makes insurance a condition of entry. The UK government advises insurance for local treatment and medical evacuation: Queen Elizabeth Hospital can cope with many types of treatment, but serious cases may need emergency evacuation, and medical treatment can be expensive.

source.name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office — Barbados travel advice (health)

onwardTicket.text: The Immigration Department lists a return ticket to your country of residence, and your intended address, among the requirements for visitors.

source.name: Barbados Immigration Department — Visitors to Barbados

proofOfFunds.text: Visitors must carry evidence of personal support, along with a return ticket and their intended address. No minimum sum is published.

declarations.name: Barbados online immigration and customs form
declarations.text: The Immigration Department says travellers must complete the online Immigration and Customs Form, which becomes available 72 hours before arrival, and present the receipts, saved to a mobile device or printed, to Immigration and Customs on arrival.

source.name: Barbados Immigration Department — Visitors to Barbados

currencyLimits.text: No official source we could read states a currency declaration threshold for Barbados.

notes: Canada's travel advice says it is an offence for civilians in Barbados to wear camouflage clothing or carry items made of camouflage material, and to bring such items into or out of the country.

payments.text: Canada's travel advice says US dollars and euros are easily exchanged for Barbadian dollars at banks and exchange bureaus, and recommends carrying cash because some smaller businesses accept only cash. The CIA World Factbook notes that the Barbadian dollar is pegged to the US dollar at two to one.

safety.text: The UK Foreign Office says there have been incidents of violent crime, including armed robbery, gang-related shootings and carjackings, some in populated and public areas, and advises avoiding isolated areas, including beaches, particularly after dark, and using only licensed taxis. It says swimming is not recommended on many east-coast beaches, where currents are particularly strong.

source.name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office — Barbados travel advice: safety and security

bestTimeToVisit.text: Canada's travel advice gives the rainy season as June to November, the same months as the Atlantic hurricane season (early June to the end of November). December to May falls outside both.

idp.text: Barbados is a party to the 1949 Geneva Convention on Road Traffic but not to the 1968 Vienna one, so the International Driving Permit it is bound to recognize is the 1949 Geneva version. A permit issued under the 1968 Vienna Convention carries no treaty obligation here.

tips.text: Canada's travel advice says wearing it, or bringing camouflage items into or out of Barbados, is an offence for civilians.
Complete the online Immigration and Customs Form, available 72 hours before arrival, and save the receipts to your phone or print them: the Immigration Department says they are presented on arrival.

Traffic drives on the left. Canada's travel advice says to carry an International Driving Permit if your licence is not in English, and that drivers aged 70 or over may need a medical certificate from a Barbados-based doctor.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Barbados?
faq.answer: Most travelers do not. Citizens of the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and many Commonwealth countries enter without a visa; the foreign ministry's list gives US, Canadian and many Commonwealth nationals up to six months, and EU citizens 90 days in any 180-day period. CARICOM nationals need no visa. If your nationality needs a visa, the Immigration Department says it must be granted before you book travel.

faq.question: Do I need to fill in the Barbados travel form?
faq.answer: Yes. The Immigration Department says travellers must complete the online Immigration and Customs Form, available 72 hours before arrival, and present the receipts on arrival.

faq.question: How long can I stay in Barbados?
faq.answer: It depends on your passport. The foreign ministry's visa list gives US, Canadian and many Commonwealth nationals up to six months, EU and Schengen citizens 90 days in any 180-day period, and some nationalities 28 to 90 days; the UK government says British visitors are told how long they can stay when they arrive. Permission to enter is granted by the Immigration Officer at the port of entry. Extensions are handled by the Immigration Department at its headquarters, for a BBD 100 application fee.

faq.question: Can I work remotely from Barbados?
faq.answer: Yes. The Barbados Welcome Stamp allows people to work remotely in Barbados for up to 12 months. It costs USD 2,000 for an individual (USD 3,000 for a family bundle) and requires annual income of at least USD 50,000 and/or the means to support yourself during the stay.

faq.question: Can I use US dollars in Barbados?
faq.answer: The CIA World Factbook notes that the Barbadian dollar is pegged to the US dollar at two to one. Canada's travel advice says US dollars and euros are easily exchanged at banks and exchange bureaus, and to carry cash because some smaller businesses accept only cash.
